headline: No API change breaks the bot today and research was thin, so there are two risk ideas: show the win rate you need to break even next to the one you have, and show the highest leverage each coin's normal noise allows.

ideas.title: Break-even win rate next to your real one
ideas.why: A high win rate can still lose if losses are bigger than wins. /report and /week would show 'you need 52% wins to break even after fees, you're at 44%', worked out from your own average win, loss and fees, so you see when small wins are hiding a leak.

ideas.title: Max leverage that fits the coin's noise
ideas.why: Each scanner card would show the highest leverage where a normal 1.5× ATR swing on 15m costs under, say, 30% of margin. On a jumpy coin that might be 12×, so reaching for 40× after a loss shows up as clearly too big before you enter.
